newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,134 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,134 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,134 contracts compared with 4,365 overnight Sunday.
There were 43 wheat, 585 corn, 437 soybean, 10 soymeal, 22 soyoil, two oat, one corn call, 20 corn puts, four soybean calls and 10 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 2-1/2 cents higher, corn was 1/4 to one cent lower and soybeans were one to 3-1/4 cents higher.
